scope: Original407train parents, fixed5flightfolds3seeds, H26K50 and40070parameters; no developmentvalidation/sealed/reserved, no outcome-selected windows.

kinematics.native: Reintegrate everyv40modelrate tape with original midpoint quaternion update; require exact stored quaternion equality.
kinematics.gate: Primarywarm2_plus/v35 full1s true-rate tiltRMSE <=50%native; >=4/5flights improve. Otherwise stop before calibration/training preparation. This is a diagnostic suitability check, not a physical noise bound.

loss.gravity: g(q)=R_nb(q).T*[0,0,1], normalizeq; yaw and quaternion-sign invariant. No Euler singularity. Localmetric=d_pitch^2+cos(pitch)^2*d_roll^2, not equal Euler weights away from small pitch.
loss.old_terms: All v35 global attitude/rate/velocity plus localrate terms retained unchanged.
loss.zero: Exact call to v35objective withlocalweight1, skip extra loss graph.

coefficient.samples: Exactly first4frozen32-parent draws for each of3seeds in thisfold; freshoriginalinitialization; pairedv34localoffsets;12gradientpairs. Commonweight across3seeds per fold.
coefficient.exclusions: No OOF gradients, no coefficient search, no recalibration after seeing final-model gradients.
coefficient.final_fit_audit: Same fixed fit-only batches at v35final checkpoints, report only. Does not set weight.

training.initialization: Same original fresh40070parameter initialization asv35, not finetuning.
training.samples: Exact v34parentdraws and localoffsets; no extra recurrent branch for tilt; extra quaternion operations/backprop still add cost.
training.control: First full1600step zero-tilt fold0seed17 exactly reproduce frozenv35 weights/buffers.

evaluation.primary: OOF complete1s tiltRMSE improves>=5% vs v35, all3seeds improve and>=4/5flights improve.
evaluation.protections: Original18: p/r1s waveform andvelocity/attitude.5/1s endpoints perseed regress<=5%; addq1swave perseed androll/pitch1swave perseed,27total.
evaluation.legacy: Report originalq>=5%improvement condition separately; do not relabel tilt success as a q gate pass.
evaluation.coupled: All4v40variants andall407parents withgeneratedactions. Surface0/1 meanRMSE improves>=5%, allseeds and>=4/5flights improve; all4actionchannels perseed regress<=5%. Keep state protections and absolute gates on coupled trajectories.
evaluation.promotion: No automatic control-readiness promotion. Five flights repeatedly used for development; exactfirmware andindependentcontrolresponse remain unproven.
